title: Last night was crazy
content: After spending a good 2hr+ interacting with an outside mall world , the simulation just ended and everybody just froze / time stopped! I was the only one left & everything was frozen in time😱 When this happened I gained consciousness outside the simulation & I realized this mall word was just a video stream show that ended. Naturally to my mind , I tuned out the show that ended & tuned in into another stream that was about to start. When this happened , I got thrown in 1st person view into this new mall world. This new word was similar & close to the other location that ended but with different people (family this time) / different locations that become open (McDonald's 😂). Very hard to explain in words but I was a space brain that tuned in to video streams that would become available / open in order to be able to dream / visit mall worlds.
